plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math (STEM), Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 2006S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/engineering-physical-and-computer-sciences-department/science-technology-engineering-and-math-stem/science-technology-engineering-and-math-stem-associate-of-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Science (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60 - the shared minimum of the two totals the page prints ('Total Credit Hours: 60-65' after the semester tables and 'Total Credit Hours: 60-63' at the bottom); semester tables print 14-17/16/15/15. Modeled honestly per corpus convention (minimum-credit path + notes): 'ELEC College level Elective Courses 4-6 Credits' in Fall Freshman at 5 (the value that makes the semester sum to the printed 14 with MATH at minimum 3); 'MATH 143 College Algebra (3 cr) OR MATH 147 College Algebra and Trigonometry (5 cr) OR MATH 170 Calculus 1 (5 cr)' at 3 (MATH 143). Semester totals 14/16/15/15 = 60. Choice slots: PROG ELEC 4 + 5 + 9 = 18 credits (the catalog's required minimum of 18 program-elective credits; at least one course from each of the Life Science, Physical Science/Engineering, and Math/Technology groups on the page); COMM GE / SCIG GE / WELL GE / SCIG GE2 / SOCS GE / HUMA GE / HUMA GE2 / SOCS GE2 are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Catalog rules: credits cannot be earned in both MATH 143 & MATH 147, nor in both MATH 144 & MATH 147. Footnotes: Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Humanistic & Artistic Way of Knowing courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Social and Behavioral Way of Knowing courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
